scope: New Q2 descriptive analysis and fixed historical-reference diagnostics, then candidate explanation; no fitted predictor, optimizer, control simulation or result2
reference_policy: User-supplied teammate markdown is methods-only; its numbers, figures, tables and computed conclusions are excluded as evidence; no linked external figure/data files used
time: interval start = source_date + source_minute, duration1/6h; 0:00+1 belongs to next actual date; actual series never circularly rotated within source day
coverage: Primary complete submission period2025-02-01 to2025-12-31; seasonal description also2025-01-02 to2025-12-31 complete days. Missing2025-01-01 first interval is not filled;2026-01-01 start is not put back into2025
diagnostic_protocol: Each zero-hour reference uses only fully finished prior intervals; fixed methods evaluated throughoutFeb-Dec with first/second half and month groups. No setting selected, trained or tuned. Full-year observations already viewed, not an untouched holdout
error_continuity: Two prespecified reference pairs: load lag7/PV mean7, load sameweekday4/PV mean7. Net error is actual(L-PV)-reference(L-PV), without clipping. Within-day autocorrelation and1/3/6h signed cumulative errors; overlapping windows are not independent samples
physical_checks: PV direct supply, surplus and positive net demand at each10min; shared5000kW charge limit; power-only unavoidable PV spill lower bound. These are derived input quantities, not simulated spill or emergency purchases
budget: One descriptive/diagnostic batch and independent verification; at most6 code figures,300dpi PNG plus vectorPDF; no optimization/fit or grid tuning
stop: Deliver findings, limitations, four-view candidate space and finite proposed trial plan; no auto model choice, freeze, Q2 trial or Q3 work
